basic_info.description: Modern Dolores Heights condo with downtown views situated in an unbeatable location -- steps to Dolores Park and a quick walk to the Castro, Market Street, and the Mission. Enjoy the perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhood. This move-in-ready unit features an open floor plan with a spacious living room with a gas fireplace and large view windows, a separate dining area, and a kitchen with center island. Down the hall is a guest bedroom and full bathroom, adjacent is a primary bedroom with an en-suite bathroom and large, outfitted walk-in closet. Off the primary bedroom are sliding doors leading to a deeded patio. In addition, this condo features an in-unit washer/dryer (in a walk-in closet with great storage), deeded parking with storage, and an elevator from the garage straight to the unit. This wonderful condo checks all the boxes!
